headline: Notion Kills Its Email App, Claims AI Agents Have Replaced the Inbox
reasoning: This topic scores exceptionally high on clickability and mainstream appeal due to its provocative core claim: AI agents are making traditional email inboxes obsolete. The story involves a major, popular brand (Notion), industry drama (killing an acquired product), and a forward-looking angle that directly impacts a universal user behavior (checking email). It's a perfect fit for multiple formats, including a hot take, an explainer on 'AI email agents', or a listicle of alternative tools.
summary: Notion is shutting down its Notion Mail client, which was built from the acquisition of Skiff. The company claims the reason is that a majority of users now prefer to manage their email using AI agents rather than a traditional inbox.

source_articles.title: Notion killing Skiff-influenced email app since most users use AI agents instead
source_articles.excerpt: Notion is "going all in on using agents to run your inbox."
